---
title: "Contribute"
description: >-
  How to report an error, how to propose a change, and the licence of a
  contribution.
---

Corrections and suggestions are welcome.

## Report an error

Open an issue in the
[repository on GitHub](https://github.com/taspinar/physics-by-construction/issues).
Say which page it is on, quote the sentence, number, or figure that is wrong,
and say what you expected. If a listing does not run on your machine, add
your operating system and the output of `./scripts/preflight.sh`.

Do not put secrets in an issue. A security-sensitive finding follows the
[security policy](https://github.com/taspinar/physics-by-construction/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## Propose a change

Start with an issue that describes the problem or the proposal. Changes land
through pull requests, and a pull request cannot be merged while
`./scripts/verify.sh` fails. The
[contributing guide](https://github.com/taspinar/physics-by-construction/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
has the steps, and the
[authoring guide](https://github.com/taspinar/physics-by-construction/blob/main/docs/authoring.md)
explains how to write a lesson.

To propose a new lesson, open an issue from the **Lesson proposal** form.
The assessment criteria, and the path from an accepted proposal to a merged
lesson, are in the
[content proposals guide](https://github.com/taspinar/physics-by-construction/blob/main/docs/content-proposals.md).
A draft may be written by you or, from an accepted proposal, by an agent on
the maintainer's machine; either way it lands through a reviewed pull
request that passes the same verification as every lesson.

## Licence of contributions

By submitting a contribution you agree that it is licensed under the licences
of the repository:

- code, including lesson code, tests, and Lean proofs, under the
  [MIT licence](https://github.com/taspinar/physics-by-construction/blob/main/LICENSE);
- lesson text and figures under the
  [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence](https://github.com/taspinar/physics-by-construction/blob/main/LICENSE-CONTENT).

Only contribute material you have the right to license this way. When you
include third-party material, name its source and licence in the pull
request.
